g.text: The systems the business layer harvested that serve customers and the books, with the connections drafted from the process map and the pattern library, and the estate systems they reach. Every connection carries its integration style and names its pattern in the inspector; the operations chain is its own drawing.
Proposed throughout, so an owner has something to confirm or strike.
